description: This header file declares the interface for the RDK IARM-Bus API, including function pointers, event handlers, and functions for initializing, connecting, disconnecting, publishing events, registering handlers, and invoking RPC methods within the IARM communication framework.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Init
methods.description: Initializes the IARM-Bus library with a specified client name, setting up the application for bus communication.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Term
methods.description: Terminates the IARM-Bus library, releasing allocated resources and reverting to pre-initialization state.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Connect
methods.description: Connects the application to the IARM bus, enabling event and RPC communication.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the application from the IARM bus, disabling event and RPC communication.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_BroadcastEvent
methods.description: Publishes an asynchronous event to all registered clients.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if a specified application member is registered and connected to the IARM bus.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterEventHandler
methods.description: Registers an event handler callback for a specific event and owner.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_UnRegisterEventHandler
methods.description: Removes all handlers registered for a specific event.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RemoveEventHandler
methods.description: Removes a specific handler for a given event and owner.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterCall
methods.description: Registers an RPC method with a handler implementation that other applications can invoke.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Call
methods.description: Invokes an RPC method by owner and method name, passing arguments.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Call_with_IPCTimeout
methods.description: Invokes an RPC method with a specified timeout for response.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterEvent
methods.description: Registers all events up to a specified maximum event ID for publishing.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_WritePIDFile
methods.description: Writes the process ID to a specified file path.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_GetContext
methods.description: Retrieves the group context of the calling member.
